_comment: FUND TAXONOMY OVERRIDES — hand-verified dispositions for funds whose vendor type (funds_view.fund_type / classification, from the price vendor) contradicts the fund's own registered name or prospectus. Applied by applyFundTaxonomy() in content/fund-categories.ts on EVERY public surface (fund page, hubs, rankings, categories, related funds, list + detail API, CSV). An 'override' entry needs primary-source evidence (regulator or issuer document, else two independent press records) and states the vendor value it replaces; a 'keep_vendor' entry records that the name-vs-type conflict was reviewed and the vendor is right. Nothing here is inferred: a fund without an entry keeps the vendor type, and an unreviewed conflict is reported by the live audit (FUND_TAXONOMY_CONFLICT) until it gets a disposition. Dimensions are orthogonal: primary_asset_class is the asset class; strategy_tags (index, sector, daily_yield, capital_protected, periodic_income) and Shariah compliance are separate properties, never substitutes for the class.

overrides.note: The FRA-hosted prospectus update names the fund «صندوق بنك نكست التجاري (النقدي) ذو العائد اليومي بالجنيه المصري» — a daily-yield money-market fund. The disclosed investment policy (T-bills, bank deposits, certificates of deposit) and the registered name in both languages agree; the vendor's 'balanced' has no source.

overrides.fund_name_en: Nasser Social Bank and Azimut Egypt Islamic Money Market fund
overrides.fund_name: صندوق استثمار بنك ناصر الاجتماعي وأزيموت مصر النقدي الإسلامي
overrides.note: The issuing bank's own page titles the fund «النقدي الاسلامي» and describes a daily cumulative return from high-liquidity instruments; Al Mal reported the launch as «صندوقاً نقدياً إسلامياً». The registered name says Money Market in both languages. Shariah compliance is a separate property (is_shariah), not the asset class.

overrides.fund_name_en: Mubasher Capital Daily Cumulative Return Fund Cash Mubasher
overrides.fund_name: صندوق استثمار مباشر كابيتال ذو العائد اليومي التراكمي - كاش مباشر
overrides.note: Registered as «صندوق استثمار مباشر كابيتال ذو العائد اليومي التراكمي (كاش مباشر حاليا)» in the FRA company record; Amwal Al Ghad (7 Oct 2022) reports Mubasher Capital restructured the former Misr El Kheir periodic-return fund into a new money-market fund («صندوق نقدي») with a daily cumulative return. Medium confidence: the FRA record confirms the name, the fund type rests on the manager's public statements.

overrides.fund_name_en: Granite Fixed Income Fund Issuance 1 EGP
overrides.fund_name: صندوق استثمار جرانيت لأدوات الدخل الثابت - الإصدار الأول النقدي بالجنيه
overrides.note: The Arabic name carries both «لأدوات الدخل الثابت» (fixed-income instruments) and «النقدي بالجنيه» (the EGP cash share class); the English registered name says Fixed Income. The name agrees with the vendor; «النقدي» here qualifies the issuance, not the asset class.
